target.statement: MaskCD reduces CHAIR_s to 40.6 and CHAIR_i to 10.8 on LLaVA-1.5-7b (vs baseline 50.2/15.4), the paper's headline hallucination-mitigation result
target.dataset: 500 random images from COCO 2014 validation set, caption prompt 'Please describe this image in detail.'

compute.basis: Requires downloading LLaVA-1.5-7b (~14GB) and COCO val2014, running 500 caption generations twice (original + masked) plus a 500-image image-head discovery pass, and CHAIR scoring with an object detector; all feasible on CPU but slow (7B model, ~2x inference cost of CD).

blockers: Repo may not include the exact image-head mask for LLaVA-1.5-7b at tau=0.9, requiring re-running the 500-image attention-recording pass
CHAIR evaluation needs COCO ground-truth annotations and an object detector (e.g., GRiT) that may not be packaged
CPU-only inference of a 7B LVLM over 500 images is slow; no GPU available
title: MaskCD: Mitigating LVLM Hallucinations by Image Head Masked Contrastive Decoding
